camera_mapping_rule: exact RoboLab pinhole intrinsics/extrinsics intersected with the calibrated table-object centroid plane; calibration estimates only a per-camera localizer pixel bias
cross_camera_threshold_source: excluded 51xx future dry run p90=0.187 m, rounded up to 0.20 m; both-camera categorical agreement remains mandatory
future_rule: at least 2 of 4 non-conditioning frames must be reliable; true if at least 75% of reliable frames satisfy the request; false if at most 25% do; uncertain otherwise
localizer_prompt: This is one fixed third-person camera looking at a robot and wood table. Locate the physical multicolored Rubik's cube and the red bowl. Return their center points as normalized coordinates from 0 to 1000. Ignore the robot, banana, wood, and background. JSON only: {"cube_center":[x,y] or null,"bowl_center":[x,y] or null}.
relation_rule: robot-frame 45-degree cone; execution additionally requires |delta_z| <= 0.1 m
